newsitem.title: USA: GTE to relocate some staff to Dallas.
newsitem.headline: GTE to relocate some staff to Dallas.

text.p: GTE Corp said Friday that it will move some its corporate and operating staff to the greater Dallas area, where its telephone operations and directories businesses are located, from its corporate headquarters in Stamford, Conn.

The company said the move will begin within the next few months and continue through 1998. About 650 employees work in GTE's headquarters and nearby training facility in Norwalk. The company added, however, that it did not yet know how many employees would be transferred to Dallas.

GTE chairman and chief executive officer Charles Lee said, "The opportunities presented by the Telecommunications Act and the explosive growth of our businesses make it imperative that we integrate and, in the near future, centralize where practicable GTE's staff functions into single unified departments to support 'one company, one brand, one face' to our customers."
He added that the company will be providing further details of its plans over the next 30 to 90 days.
